otherFindings.summary: The built-in Sidekiq adapter is deprecated in 8.1 and needs Sidekiq 7.3.3 or later, while the app is on Sidekiq 6.5.12, a combination with Rails 8.1 the report doesn't know to be tested (high).
Rails 8.2 will remove features that now emit deprecation warnings, such as the Sidekiq adapter and `to_time_preserves_timezone`, and production has `report_deprecations = false` (medium).
